cohort: 121 pregnant women with pre-eclampsia or severe pre-eclampsia
finding: Pre-eclampsia and severe pre-eclampsia were associated with increased perinatal morbidity and neonatal mortality, with severe pre-eclampsia being more strongly associated with adverse outcomes including lower APGAR scores, higher rates of ICU admission and maternal mortality.
followup_time: Immediate maternal and fetal outcomes were recorded, therefore no specific length of follow-up time was explicitly stated.
